description: Planted by moai. Edit it by hand and the next `moai skill install` overwrites it.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v -- "moai" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; trap '\''exit 0'\'' PIPE; h="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/moai-hook-$PPID-$$.handoff"; c=0; o=$(MOAI_HOOK_HANDOFF="$h" "moai" hook pre-tool-use --dialect codex) || c=$?; set -C; case "$c" in 0|1) [ -z "$o" ] || { printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$o" && [ -O "$h" ] && ! [ -h "$h" ] && read -r m 2>>/dev/null < "$h" && ! [ -e "$m" ] && ! [ -h "$m" ] && true 2>>/dev/null > "$m"; } || :;; *) case "$o" in '\''{'\''*'\''}'\'') printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$o" || :;; *) s="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/moai-hook-462f-$PPID.pre-tool-use.$c.said"; { ! [ -e "$s" ] && ! [ -h "$s" ] && true 2>>/dev/null > "$s" || ! [ -f "$s" ] || ! [ -O "$s" ] || [ -h "$s" ]; } && printf '\''{"systemMessage":"moai: the %s hook could not run (exit %s): %s. The five moai rules are not standing - run moai skill status to see why."}'\'' '\''pre-tool-use'\'' "$c" "moai" || :;; esac;; esac; exit 0'
